note: One oracle for two implementations. The compiled server validator (api/src/report-citation.ts) and the later client comparator (S3-U2b) each implement the rule separately; if they disagree the person sees the same sentence called present on one surface and absent on the other. Every vector here is a whole-line, consecutive, non-overlapping block match after CRLF, lone CR and NFC normalization applied ONLY to the comparison operands - stored bytes are never normalized. `assembly` is S3-U2b's R5 template and is deliberately not exercised by U2a product code; it is pinned here so the two halves cannot drift.
normalization: CRLF -> LF, lone CR -> LF, NFC. The same equality decides both k (occurrences in a field) and sameTextCount (entries carrying the same text).
